original_test_intent: Run licensed NVqual Test18's concurrent SSD FIO workload on the exact approved disposable SSD set and verify the module, storage performance/integrity and firmware identities meet a project-defined Test18 oracle without harming protected data.
original_method: Verify NVqual/FIO hashes/licenses/config and GPU/SSD/platform compatibility; map every drive serial/model/namespace/BDF/slot and prove targets are nonboot/disposable/backed up; inspect Test18 job profile for read/write mix, offsets, size, queue/jobs/runtime and concurrency; capture health/endurance baseline; run once under capacity/thermal/power/OOB supervision; preserve per-drive and aggregate results/exit; validate data/integrity, SMART/media errors/logs and cleanup.
manual_activity: Storage/NVIDIA owner supplies licensed artifacts, target set, data authorization and performance oracle; operator maintains cooling/power/OOB.
safety_requirements: Never select by /dev order or all disks

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Conceptually aligned but not executable until proprietary module and exact target/job configuration are supplied.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the pinned NVqual Test18 config after serial-based target preview and destructive-write approval; retain native NVqual and FIO artifacts.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Test number 18 and concurrent SSD FIO scope retained; omitted workload parameters stay pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preflight the resolved Test18 job against serial-bound targets, then report per-drive and aggregate performance, integrity and health deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit I/O content, immutable targeting, backup, bounds, numerical acceptance and cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readable output and correct firmware do not prove concurrent SSD FIO performance or data safety.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent direct writes can destroy data, consume endurance and amplify power/thermal load; aggregate success can mask one slow/failing device.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines drive population/capacity, preconditioning, read/write mix, runtime, queue/jobs, per-drive versus aggregate IOPS/BW/latency targets and allowed SMART/endurance delta.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure/title require concurrent SSD FIO, but Master Criteria only address report readability and firmware and provide no workload/performance/integrity acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; execution gated by proprietary package, safe target set, bounded profile and performance oracle.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row445 Wistron-NV GPU-00138-V001: approve NVqual Test18/FIO versions/checksums/license/config, exact SSD serial/namespace/BDF/slot/firmware target set with nonboot/backup proof, read-write/preconditioning/runtime/queue/jobs/concurrency, per-drive/aggregate IOPS/BW/latency/integrity targets, endurance/thermal/power/SMART stops and recovery.

review_improvement: Adds the missing data-safety and technical performance verdict to a criterion that otherwise checks only report presentation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Concurrent FIO can pass at aggregate level while one SSD is missing or slow, and any write-capable profile may destroy data. Target identity, per-device results and post-health/integrity are therefore essential independent gates.
